### VX Client v0.1.4 Release Notes

- Fix black screen on launch.
- Dynamic Launcher Versioning: Settings & splash screen dynamically display the active version.
- Home Page 3D Skin: Auto-rotation disabled; character faces forward, continuously waves hand, and moves head towards the cursor.
- Partnership Announcement Popup: 16:9 banner support with partner logo avatar and clean fallback.
- Responsive UI & Sidebar: Smooth layout scaling across all window resize states.
- Verified Cryptographic Updates: Official Minisign signed update flow.
